## Books Job Status

**Endpoint:** GET /webhook/books-job-status

**Request:**
```
GET /webhook/books-job-status?job_id=job_abc123
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "job_id": "job_abc123",
  "status": "in_progress",
  "text_name": "The Book of Maccabees II",
  "chapter": 1,
  "current_verse": 15,
  "total_verses": 41,
  "translations_saved": 14,
  "progress_percent": 34.1,
  "tokens": {
    "total": 25000
  }
}
```
